entry.summary: Learn how a Polymarket TWAP market maker can combine time-weighted reference prices, order-book state, inventory, and quote risk. A conventional market maker asks a simple question: where should I quote relative to the current market? A TWAP-aware market maker asks a harder question: How should the quote change when the current market price temporarily diverges from a time-weighted reference price? That distinction matters because a prediction-market order book can move faster than the information represented by a short-horizon reference price. Polymarket now documents Chainlink-computed 30-second and 60-second TWAP feeds through its real-time data infrastructure. entry.title: What an attacker gains from CVE-2026-7273 on a Zyxel GS1900 switch
entry.summary:
What an attacker gains from CVE-2026-7273 on a Zyxel GS1900 switch
CVE-2026-7273 lets an unauthenticated attacker on the local network run OS commands on a Zyxel GS1900 switch. CISA added the flaw to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 21 September 2026, which means the exploitation is not theoretical. Understanding what the attacker gets after the overflow explains why a switch bug receives the same urgency as a server bug, and it also shapes what defenders should check. The vulnerable component is the CGI program behind the switch's web management interface. A crafted HTTP request overflows a stack buffer, and the overwrite can be used to redirect execution into attacker-controlled data.
